description: This Java source file defines an abstract factory class for creating conditional elements used in a mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It manages different conditional implementations based on XML elements and supports extension through service loaders.

classes.name: ConditionalFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class for creating Conditional instances based on XML elements, supporting extension with custom conditional implementations.

methods.name: makeConditional
methods.description: Creates a Conditional object based on the provided XML element's tag name using registered factories.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Abstract method to create a specific Conditional instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the name associated with the factory.
